description: The file 'Parser.cpp' contains implementations for string parsing classes 'TextParser' and 'PathParser' in the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It handles reading text segments, parsing file paths and extensions, and associated string manipulations.

classes.name: TextParser
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing text data, providing methods to read text segments based on delimiters, skip characters, and find positions within the text.

classes.name: PathParser
classes.description: A class that extends TextParser to parse file paths, extracting drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

methods.name: uint32_t ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[],const uint32_t offset) const
methods.description: Reads a text fragment up to a delimiter, returning the endpoint position.

methods.name: ReadText (overload)
methods.description: Reads a text fragment bounded by delimiters and stores it in a provided result object.

methods.name: void Parse(const TextFragment & input)
methods.description: Parses a file path into drive, path, filename, extension, and base filename components.

ctags.name: ReadText
ctags.pattern: /^    uint32_t TextParser::ReadText(const TCHAR delimiters[], const uint32_t offset) const$/
